title: [Master] Fix Expense Agent account filters with special characters
summary: Expense Agent now properly handles G/L account lookups when account names or descriptions contain special characters like apostrophes or parentheses by quoting and escaping filter expressions.
key_points: Fixed account search filter to quote and escape embedded apostrophes
Prevents localized descriptions with parentheses or apostrophes from being misinterpreted as filter operators
Preserves case-insensitive matching and wildcard behavior
Applies to both G/L account-name lookup and account-subcategory fallback paths
Added regression tests for parentheses and apostrophes in both lookup scenarios
